description: This is a PHPUnit test case class for testing the CustomerDao within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes setup, fixture loading, various CRUD operation tests, and exception handling tests related to Customer entities.

classes.name: CustomerDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing CustomerDao's CRUD operations, querying, fixture setup, and exception handling in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes CustomerDao and ProjectDao instances before tests.

methods.name: populateCustomerServiceFixture
methods.description: Loads fixture data for CustomerService tests from CustomerService.yml.

methods.name: populateCustomerDaoFixture
methods.description: Loads fixture data specific to CustomerDao from CustomerDao.yaml.

methods.name: testAddCustomer
methods.description: Tests adding a new customer and verifies the returned Customer object.

methods.name: testGetCustomerList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of customers with default filter.

methods.name: testFilterByCustomerName
methods.description: Filters customers by name 'Orange' and checks the result.

methods.name: testGetCustomerById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a customer by ID (1) and verifies name and description.

methods.name: testGetCustomerByIdOnNull
methods.description: Verifies behavior when retrieving a non-existent customer ID.

methods.name: testGetCustomer
methods.description: Tests the getCustomer method with a non-specific ID.

methods.name: testUpdateCustomer
methods.description: Tests updating customer details and verifies changes.

methods.name: testDeleteCustomer
methods.description: Tests deleting customers and checks the project count afterwards.

methods.name: testGetCustomerIdList
methods.description: Verifies getting list of customer IDs, including optional entries.

methods.name: testGetCustomerIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Tests retrieving customer IDs for a project admin user for different IDs.

methods.name: testExceptionForDeleteCustomer
methods.description: Verifies that deleting certain customers triggers a CustomerServiceException.

methods.name: testGetUnselectableCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves and verifies IDs of customers that cannot be selected.
